verdict.rationale: Monday's docs advertise robust dashboards, custom views, and enterprise-scale automation/integrations implying it can handle large workspaces, but no documentation specifies item caps or performance benchmarks at scale. Multiple community reports describe severe slowness and even a custom-built, admittedly poor-performing database (8s→3s to fetch just 5,000 items), directly contradicting any implicit claim of smooth performance at tens of thousands of items.
